verdict.rationale: Vue is positioned as a framework for building web UIs with a reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system (vue-docs-1, vue-docs-4). Hands-on users praise its ergonomic API for managing component state (vue-comm-2) and single-file components that encapsulate HTML, JS and styles (vue-comm-8). Some community members say it is weaker for complex apps or that global stores hurt modularity (vue-comm-7, vue-comm-19, vue-comm-20), but these are opinions rather than concrete failures. Missing for 10: first-party docs in the pack explicitly describing component encapsulation, local state APIs and composition patterns (props/slots/emits), plus concrete evidence of composing large complex UIs.
